conversation_types.name: General Media Narration
conversation_types.short_description: Any media style content with a single speaker that talks exclusively in the third person

conversation_types.name: Multiple Speakers Livestreamed Media
conversation_types.short_description: Any improvised media content that features several speakers and explicitly exists for entertainment or social purposes

conversation_types.name: Media Interview or Talk Show
conversation_types.short_description: Conversations in media formatted as one on one interviews, host with one or more guests, or podcasts formatted as question and answer shows.

conversation_types.name: General Media Dialogue
conversation_types.short_description: Any conversation with multiple speaking participants that's scripted featuring other things like music or sound effects

conversation_types.name: Social Media Content
conversation_types.short_description: Any content with a narrator that's formatted in a way that's targeted for social media.

conversation_types.name: Single Speaker Livestreamed Media
conversation_types.short_description: Any media content that features only one speaker that's improvised and explicitly exists for entertainment or social purposes

conversation_types.name: Online Game Chat
conversation_types.short_description: Any social chat where the participants are brought together to play a game

conversation_types.name: Online Chat Room
conversation_types.short_description: Any conversation with several participants who appear to be strangers, in a large group, or have the ability to talk over each other.

conversation_types.name: Social Phone or Video Call
conversation_types.short_description: Any call with two to five participants that's explicitly for the purpose of socializing

participant_roles.name: Narrator
participant_roles.short_description: A media participant who speaks in the third person exclusively

participant_roles.name: Social Participant
participant_roles.short_description: A partipant in a social conversation
